# addons (cloudspider-addons) v1.0.0

Cluster add-ons for an EKS cluster from upgrades/eks: one stack per add-on and cluster, named <addon>-<cluster> (kyverno-cloudspider-up). See catalog.js.

## Inputs

Set with `pulumi config set <key> <value>` or the STACKS card. Validated before any resource is created (upgrades/schema); the card runs the same check before it makes the stack.

| key | allowed | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| clusterName | must be a short lowercase name (a-z, 0-9, -; 2-28 chars, starts with a letter) | cloudspider-up | the EKS cluster it runs on |
| skipRoomCheck | on \| off | off | skip the free pod slot check (pod-room.js) |
| defaultDeny | on \| off | on | kyverno: default-deny NetworkPolicy in new namespaces |
| capacity | spot \| on-demand | spot | karpenter: node capacity |
| maxPods | auto \| 32 \| 58 | 32 | karpenter: kubelet maxPods |
| zones | must be a comma list of zones like eu-north-1a,eu-north-1b |  | karpenter: zones (default: all the cluster's) |
| hpa | on \| off | on | scaling-demo: HPA on demo/web, demo/api |
| burst | on \| off | off | scaling-demo: load burst |
| inflate | 0..6 | 0 | scaling-demo: inflate pods |
| demoApp | absent \| present | absent | scaling-demo: set by the card |
